commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; test "$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'; OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; cleanup(){ rm -f "$OUT/p0-room.sqlite"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; sleep 1; echo DB_FILES_BEGIN; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'ls -l databases' | sed -E 's/[0-9]{4,}/N/g'; echo DB_FILES_END; MAGIC=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'dd if=databases/tracker_database bs=16 count=1 2>/dev/null' | xxd -p -c 32); echo TRACKER_DATABASE_MAGIC=$MAGIC; test "$MAGIC" = '53514c69746520666f726d6174203300'; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'cat databases/tracker_database' > "$OUT/p0-room.sqlite"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3, hashlib
p=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912/p0-room.sqlite"
assert p.read_bytes()[:16] == b'SQLite format 3\x00'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
tables={r[0] for r in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")}
assert 'devices' in tables
total=con.execute('select count(*) from devices').fetchone()[0]
max_seen=con.execute('select max(lastSeenAt) from devices').fetchone()[0]
recent=con.execute('select count(*) from devices where lastSeenAt >= ?', ((max_seen or 0)-180000,)).fetchone()[0] if max_seen is not None else 0
print('DEVICE_TOTAL', total)
print('DENSE_180S_WINDOW_AT_DATASET_TAIL', recent)
if 'signal_samples' in tables:
    print('SIGNAL_SAMPLE_TOTAL', con.execute('select count(*) from signal_samples').fetchone()[0])
print('DB_TABLE_COUNT', len(tables))
print('DB_BASELINE_SHA256', hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
con.close()
PY
echo DATASET_BASELINE_CAPTURE_PASS; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
